description: Saves a Zillow or Redfin listing to the user's DoorMeter deals, exactly as the card's Save button does (read from its page in a tab, with the active profile), optionally with a first note. Saving a home that is already saved refreshes its page facts and keeps its notes, status, the user's edits, profile and strategy (unless "strategy" is given).

strategy.description: The strategy to save it in; the profile's starting strategy when left out.

url.description: A Zillow or Redfin listing URL (one home's page, e.g. a "url" from search_results).

name: save_deal
